text:
mia: Heads up — partner CloudForge just dropped a late usage file for March that didn't make the billing run. Looks like ~ $18,200 of unbilled usage (mostly embeddings). We close books EOD PDT on Mar 31. Can we accrual this or do a reclass to unbilled AR?

jon: On it. Mia can you paste the CSV here and confirm the partner PO? Need to check which ratecard was applied (marketplace vs direct).

mia: CSV pasted below. PO: 12345-CF. Partner's internal invoice used marketplace rates but contract signed direct rates — that's why totals differ.

mia: ```
date,resource,units,unit_rate,ext_amount
2026-03-15,embeddings,91000,0.20,18200.00
```

ravi: Thanks. If contract points to direct rates we should recognize the earned revenue now (service delivered) and record an unbilled receivable. Recommend JE to accrue revenue and AR. Suggest:
```
DR 1310 Unbilled Receivable 18,200.00
CR 4000 Hosting/Inference Revenue 18,200.00
Memo: Accrual for CloudForge Mar usage (PO 12345-CF) pending partner invoice.
```
We'll post a reversing JE if invoice doesn't arrive within the reversal window.

pam: Need two things before posting: (1) PO and partner acknowledgement (email or the partner CSV with signature), (2) controller approval for > $10k. Jon can you confirm?

jon: I can approve once accounting has the PO and a quick line-by-line recon vs contract rates. Also want a screenshot of the contract clause that shows direct rate.

mia: Contract excerpt pasted: "CloudForge SOW v2 — Embeddings unit price = $0.20 per 1k tokens (direct rate). Marketplace fee not applicable."

accounting-bot: Auto-recon complete: suggested_total=18200.00, tax=0.00, suggested_je_id=ACCR-284321, supporting_files=[cloudforge_mar_usage.csv, cf_sow_v2.pdf].

ravi: That works. Mia please email accounting@redwood.com with the PO, partner confirmation, and the CF SOW clip. We'll book to GL 1310/4000 and set a reversal for Apr 15 if invoice not posted.

pam: I'll prepare the accrual JE draft and leave it pending until Jon signs off. Reversal template: DR 4000 / CR 1310 on reversal date.

jon: Approve to post pre-close assuming the vendor email + PO are in accounting inbox before EOD. :thumbsup:

mia: Partner confirmed via email, ETA invoice 2026-04-05. I just CC'd accounting@redwood.com with PO 12345-CF and the CSV + SOW excerpt.

pam: Posted JE draft ID JE-284321-03 (status: posted after controller approval). Memo: "Accrual for late partner usage — CloudForge Mar (PO 12345-CF)." Reversing JE scheduled 2026-04-15 if no invoice.

jon: Noted. Please assign any later adjustments to product revenue bucket if partner invoices at marketplace rate instead of direct.

mia: Will track. I'll ping again if partner billing lands early. :pray:

pam: Closing loop — accrual posted and documented in month close binder under folder "partners/unbilled/CloudForge/Mar-2026". If anyone needs copies of the backup let me know.
